versions.changelog: Pin @dreamlayer/mcp 0.4.0-beta.5, the first build that accepts options.background, and price a kept background at the flat plain_frame_cents instead of the transparent tier.
State the measured cold-start range rather than a single worst case; connectionTimeoutMs guidance unchanged.
Carry connectionTimeoutMs in the MCP config and explain the cold npx start, which exceeds OpenClaw's five-second default.
Add the product overview, repository and API reference links to the body so they are visible on the listing.

Initial release of dreamlayer-image-workflows.

- Create finished images—originals, edits, transparent cutouts, upscales, logos, product shots, variations, batches, and sprite sheets—using DreamLayer in the working directory.
- Connects to DreamLayer’s canonical workflows; comprehensive support for common visual asset generation tasks.
- Requires Node.js 22.12+ and a DreamLayer API key; paid work spends DreamLayer credits.
- Offers reliable, contract-based workflow guidance for each image job, with robust error handling and explicit user control.
- Thorough documentation: setup, workflow contracts, limitations, cost structure, and supported operations provided.
